moved.sentence: Bake application code and dependencies **into** the image at build time.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: application code and dependencies baked into the image at build time.

moved.sentence: Inject environment-specific config at **deploy/runtime** via environment variables or a config service — do not bake secrets or per-environment values into the image.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD and SHOULD NOT (both unkeyed before): environment config injected at deploy/runtime via environment variables or a config service, and no secrets or per-environment values baked into the image.

moved.sentence: Servers are **cattle, not pets** — interchangeable and disposable, never hand-tuned and irreplaceable.

judged.note: Kept and strengthened to MUST: servers are cattle, not pets, interchangeable and disposable, never hand-tuned and irreplaceable.

moved.sentence: Pair this with **infrastructure-as-code** (see related): the artifact is built from version-controlled definitions (`Dockerfile`, Packer template) so builds are reproducible and reviewable.

judged.note: Kept verbatim at SHOULD: pair with infrastructure-as-code, artifact built from version-controlled definitions (`Dockerfile`, Packer template) so builds are reproducible and reviewable.

moved.sentence: Keep prior image versions retained and addressable (immutable tags or digests, e.g.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the full sentence: prior image versions retained and addressable by immutable tags or digests (`app@sha256:...`) so any past release can be restored deterministically.

moved.sentence: Avoid mutable tags like `latest` for what is actually deployed; pin to an immutable digest or version tag.

judged.note: Kept verbatim at SHOULD: avoid mutable tags like `latest` for what is deployed, pin to an immutable digest or version tag.

moved.sentence: Adopt heavier machinery — Kubernetes, managed image pipelines, blue-green or canary rollout infrastructure — only **when a measured need justifies it** (scale, zero-downtime SLAs, fleet size), not as a default.

judged.note: Kept verbatim at SHOULD with every example of heavier machinery, the measured-need condition and its examples, and 'not as a default'.

moved.sentence: Faster iteration: optimize image builds (layer caching, small base images) so rebuild-to-deploy stays quick enough that no one is tempted to patch in place.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: optimize image builds (layer caching, small base images) for faster iteration so rebuild-to-deploy stays quick enough that no one patches in place.
